name: David Shadrake
bio: David Shadrake is the editor of the Incognito Browser resource library. He sets editorial standards, reviews pseudonymous contributors' work for factual accuracy and reader value, and is the named accountability layer behind the site's privacy and browser-security coverage.
credentials: Editor at Incognito Browser. Consumer privacy and browser-security publishing.
areasOfExpertise: Editorial review for consumer privacy publishing
